annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it invites registration at a BitClub URL while promising daily income through mining-pool shares and wallet earnings. The speaker presents an investment amount, withdrawable funds, and projected wallet payments, while comparing a $3,500 mining plan with direct Bitcoin purchases. Although it warns against expecting fast money and describes the investment as long-term with weaker results, it still presents a registration-linked earnings and payout flow.
